```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

run_folder <- file.path("factorial1")
if (!file.exists(file.path(run_folder, "experiment_table.RDS"))) {
  run_folder <- file.path("non-repo stuff", "consumer_resource", "factorial1")
}
run_folder <- normalizePath(run_folder)

experiment_table <- readRDS(file.path(run_folder, "experiment_table.RDS")) |>
  as_tibble()

selected_cases <- experiment_table |>
  filter(
    u_opt_mean == 20,
    u_opt_range == 4,
    sd_u_mean == 2,
    temperature_replicate == 1,
    resource_specialization %in% c(0, 0.5, 1)
  ) |>
  arrange(resource_specialization)

selected_case_ids <- selected_cases$case_id
selected_env_series_ids <- unique(selected_cases$env_series_id)

sql_strings <- function(connection, values) {
  paste(as.character(dbQuoteString(connection, values)), collapse = ", ")
}

dynamics_con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), file.path(run_folder, "dynamics.db"))
dynamics <- dbGetQuery(
  dynamics_con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT * FROM dynamics WHERE case_id IN (",
    sql_strings(dynamics_con, selected_case_ids),
    ")"
  )
) |>
  as_tibble()
dbDisconnect(dynamics_con)

resources_con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), file.path(run_folder, "resources.db"))
resources <- dbGetQuery(
  resources_con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT * FROM resources WHERE case_id IN (",
    sql_strings(resources_con, selected_case_ids),
    ")"
  )
) |>
  as_tibble()
dbDisconnect(resources_con)

temperatures_con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), file.path(run_folder, "temperatures.db"))
temperatures <- dbGetQuery(
  temperatures_con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT * FROM temperatures WHERE env_series_id IN (",
    sql_strings(temperatures_con, selected_env_series_ids),
    ")"
  )
) |>
  as_tibble()
dbDisconnect(temperatures_con)

case_lookup <- selected_cases |>
  transmute(
    case_id,
    lambda = resource_specialization,
    env_series_id,
    u_opt_mean,
    u_opt_range,
    sd_u_mean,
    temperature_replicate,
    label = paste0("lambda = ", resource_specialization, " (", case_id, ")")
  )

species_ids <- paste0("Spp", seq_len(max(selected_cases$richness)))
species_colours <- setNames(
  grDevices::hcl.colors(length(species_ids), palette = "Dark 3"),
  species_ids
)

resource_colours <- setNames(
  grDevices::hcl.colors(10, palette = "Dark 3"),
  paste0("Res", seq_len(10))
)

resource_matrix_long <- function(community) {
  resource_names <- paste0("Res", seq_len(community$R))
  as_tibble(community$resource_use_ij, .name_repair = ~ resource_names) |>
    mutate(Species_ID = paste0("Spp", seq_len(community$S)), .before = 1) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(resource_names),
      names_to = "Resource_ID",
      values_to = "use_weight"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Species_ID = factor(Species_ID, levels = paste0("Spp", seq_len(community$S))),
      Resource_ID = factor(Resource_ID, levels = resource_names)
    )
}

species_parameter_table <- function(community) {
  tibble(
    Species_ID = paste0("Spp", seq_len(community$S)),
    u_max = community$u_max_i,
    u_opt = community$u_opt_i,
    sd_u = community$sd_u_i,
    death_rate = community$d_i,
    conversion_efficiency = community$e_i
  )
}

net_growth_at_supply <- function(community, temperature_values) {
  rows <- vector("list", community$S * length(temperature_values))
  row_index <- 1
  for (i in seq_len(community$S)) {
    for (temp in temperature_values) {
      u_max_temp <- community$a_u_ij[i, ] *
        exp(-0.5 * ((temp - community$u_opt_ij[i, ]) / community$sd_u_ij[i, ])^2)
      uptake_at_supply <- community$resource_use_ij[i, ] *
        u_max_temp *
        community$K_R_j /
        (community$h_ij[i, ] + community$K_R_j)
      rows[[row_index]] <- tibble(
        Species_ID = paste0("Spp", i),
        temperature = temp,
        net_growth_at_resource_supply = community$e_i[i] * sum(uptake_at_supply) - community$d_i[i]
      )
      row_index <- row_index + 1
    }
  }
  bind_rows(rows)
}

thin_group <- function(data, max_points = 1600) {
  if (nrow(data) <= max_points) {
    return(data)
  }
  data[unique(round(seq(1, nrow(data), length.out = max_points))), , drop = FALSE]
}

dynamics_plot <- dynamics |>
  mutate(Abundance_plot = pmax(Abundance, 1e-8)) |>
  group_by(case_id, Species_ID) |>
  group_modify(~ thin_group(.x)) |>
  ungroup()

resources_plot <- resources |>
  group_by(case_id, Resource_ID) |>
  group_modify(~ thin_group(.x)) |>
  ungroup()

total_biomass_data <- dynamics |>
  group_by(case_id, time) |>
  summarise(total_biomass = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(case_lookup, by = "case_id")

total_biomass_plot <- total_biomass_data |>
  group_by(case_id) |>
  group_modify(~ thin_group(.x)) |>
  ungroup()
```

## Cases Shown

These runs are drawn from the `factorial1` consumer-resource experiment. They share the same environment and thermal trait settings, but differ in resource specialization. This makes the panels useful for comparing how the resource utilisation pattern changes the dynamics.

```{r}
case_lookup |>
  select(
    case_id,
    lambda,
    env_series_id,
    u_opt_mean,
    u_opt_range,
    sd_u_mean,
    temperature_replicate
  ) |>
  kable()
```

## Environment

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
temperatures |>
  distinct(env_series_id, time, temperature) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, temperature)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, colour = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Temperature"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Community Biomass Comparison

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
total_biomass_plot |>
  mutate(lambda = factor(lambda, levels = sort(unique(lambda)))) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, total_biomass, colour = lambda)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.55) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(nrow(case_lookup), "Dark 3"), sort(unique(case_lookup$lambda)))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Total community biomass",
    colour = "Resource specialization"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=4.6}
for (row_index in seq_len(nrow(selected_cases))) {
  case <- selected_cases[row_index, ]
  community <- case$community_object[[1]]
  case_id <- case$case_id
  lambda <- case$resource_specialization
  env_series_id <- case$env_series_id

  case_temperatures <- temperatures |>
    filter(env_series_id == !!env_series_id)

  parameter_table <- species_parameter_table(community)
  temperature_grid <- seq(
    min(case_temperatures$temperature, parameter_table$u_opt) - 2,
    max(case_temperatures$temperature, parameter_table$u_opt) + 2,
    length.out = 300
  )
  net_growth_curves <- net_growth_at_supply(community, temperature_grid)

  case_dynamics <- dynamics_plot |>
    filter(case_id == !!case_id)

  case_resources <- resources_plot |>
    filter(case_id == !!case_id)

  case_total_biomass <- total_biomass_plot |>
    filter(case_id == !!case_id)

  cat("\n\n## Resource Specialization ", lambda, " (", case_id, ")\n\n", sep = "")

  cat("### Resource Utilisation Pattern\n\n")
  print(
    ggplot(resource_matrix_long(community), aes(Resource_ID, Species_ID, fill = use_weight)) +
      geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2F5D7C", limits = c(0, 1)) +
      labs(
        x = "Resource",
        y = "Species",
        fill = "Use weight"
      ) +
      coord_equal() +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
      )
  )

  cat("\n\n### Species Performance Curves\n\n")
  print(
    ggplot(net_growth_curves, aes(temperature, net_growth_at_resource_supply, colour = Species_ID)) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = min(case_temperatures$temperature),
        xmax = max(case_temperatures$temperature),
        ymin = -Inf,
        ymax = Inf,
        alpha = 0.08,
        fill = "grey35"
      ) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = species_colours) +
      labs(
        x = "Temperature",
        y = "Net growth at resource supply",
        colour = "Species"
      ) +
      theme_bw()
  )

  cat("\n\n### Species Dynamics\n\n")
  print(
    ggplot(case_dynamics, aes(time, Abundance_plot, colour = Species_ID)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.45) +
      scale_y_log10() +
      scale_colour_manual(values = species_colours) +
      labs(
        x = "Time",
        y = "Species abundance, log10 scale",
        colour = "Species"
      ) +
      theme_bw()
  )

  cat("\n\n### Resource Dynamics\n\n")
  print(
    ggplot(case_resources, aes(time, Resource, colour = Resource_ID)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.45) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = resource_colours) +
      labs(
        x = "Time",
        y = "Resource concentration",
        colour = "Resource"
      ) +
      theme_bw()
  )

  cat("\n\n### Community Biomass Dynamics\n\n")
  print(
    ggplot(case_total_biomass, aes(time, total_biomass)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.55, colour = "black") +
      labs(
        x = "Time",
        y = "Total community biomass"
      ) +
      theme_bw()
  )
}
```
